recommendedOption: A: retain the existing Jupiter V2 quote interface and build a small Wallet Standard connection layer; separately review the eventual transaction path.
decisionReason: This changes the original prebuilt-widget plan and makes GFOF responsible for more wallet lifecycle, transaction review and failure handling. The dependency footprint is smaller, but maintenance/security responsibility grows.
candidateScope: Only the wallet discovery/connect/disconnect/event layer. This is not a complete swap implementation, transaction codec review, audit of wallets or proof of safe execution.
staticReview: Read the packaged ESM wallet registry, app-ready/register event handling and features/base exports without importing or executing the code. No network/signing implementation is present in those registry/feature files. A discovered wallet itself is not authenticated by the registry.

A.mainTradeoff: GFOF owns more UI, wallet lifecycle, transaction review and failure logic.

B.scope: Full Plugin dependency graph; not directly comparable with a connection-only layer
B.mainTradeoff: More prebuilt functionality; exact source/build parity, dependency remediation, dynamic assets, auto-connect and required origins remain unaccepted.

proposedNextIncrement: Opt-in discovery of compatible installed Solana Wallet Standard wallets, manual connect/disconnect and an address-only preview.
No eager connection, sign-in message, account linking, wallet address in quote requests or custody.
Account changes, disconnects, unregisters, navigation and uncertain/late connections clear stale quote and wallet display state.
No signing or execution in that first increment. A registered wallet name/icon is not a trust certification; treat metadata as untrusted.
laterTradeAcceptance: Choose and review transaction serialization/validation components separately; the three-package audit does not cover them.
Bind an order to wallet, chain, fixed mint pair, amount and fresh approved terms; unknown or changed state must close the trade path.
Show and verify fees, minimum received, slippage and price impact against the actual transaction, not just an indicative quote.
Handle rejection, expiration, disconnect and unknown transaction outcomes without automatic repeat signing/submission.
Review provider/API budgets, production key handling and page-specific origins before public release.
Complete protected hosted, browser/mobile wallet and owner-run small-trade acceptance, followed by release approval.
boundaries: Research and review artifacts only. No app runtime dependency, wallet registration/connection, CSP expansion, signature, trade, account, cloud permission, deployment, publication to the live site or financial commitment.
